mechanism: Print/format operands are all evaluated before output. Their earlier String or borrowed-view snapshots can retain the original allocation while a later inout operation replaces or takes its owner. Rust print_parts now keeps the existing call_shared/call_mut borrow window for the entire parts list and restores only the current window on exit.
targeted_rust_regression: The separate P0 negative fixture originally emitted one E0102 and missed ten expected errors. The corrected checker emits all eleven expected E0102 positions. Its safe positive fixture passes Debug/Release with normal-return allocation checking.
